blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual–tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their synchronized tactile data remain far smaller in volume than human video. Moreover, the largest resources often merge recordings from different sensors or annotation procedures, which makes the effect of data scale difficult to isolate. In short, datasets that capture hundreds of hours of human vision and touch through one consistent sensing pipeline remain scarce. We therefore introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour dataset of contact-rich human interaction recorded with a single unified wearable setup. Its approximately 2K predefined task descriptions span everyday activities and structured manipulation, and each recording temporally aligns egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB video and dense full-hand bimanual tactile measurements. With TouchScale, we ask what scaling human visual–tactile data unlocks for perception and robot learning. Compared with prior tactile data, training on the full TouchScale raises zero-shot contact IoU on data from an unseen tactile sensor from 0.134 to 0.383. Pretraining a visual encoder on TouchScale also yields the highest action recognition accuracy on three benchmarks among the compared visual–tactile datasets. Used for visual–tactile mid-training of a robot policy, TouchScale improves the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. With the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, both zero-shot tactile prediction and robot success show an overall upward trend as more TouchScale data is used. These results suggest that human visual–tactile data collected at scale with consistent sensing benefits both perception and robot manipulation. We will publicly release TouchScale, including all synchronized visual–tactile recordings and reconstructed object models, to support future research on scalable visual–tactile learning.
blocks.zh: 大规模以自我为中心的人类互动数据正成为对所体现学习进行物理监督的重要来源,而光是视频就使物理互动特征的接触和压力没有被记录下来. 最近的视觉-tactile数据集提供了这种缺失的监管,但其同步触觉数据在体积上仍然比人类视频要小得多. 此外,最大的资源常常合并不同传感器或注释程序的录音,这使得数据尺度的效果难以分离. 简言之,能够捕捉数百小时人类视觉和通过一个一致的感知管道来触摸的数据集仍然稀缺. 因此,我们引入了TouchScale,一个500小时的数据集,用一个统一的可穿戴装置记录的接触丰富的人类互动。 其约2K预定义的任务描述跨越了日常活动和有条理地操控,每次录制时把以自负为中心的RGB-D视频与手腕RGB视频和密集的双手双相触控测量相配合. 使用触摸尺度,我们问人类视觉-动能数据如何解锁感知和机器人学习。 与先前的触觉数据相比,关于全触觉分级的培训将来自一个看不见的触觉传感器的数据上的零发接头IoU从0.134提高到0.383. 在触摸尺度上预先培训一个可视化编码器,在比较的可视-可活性数据集中,三个基准的动作识别精度也最高。 用于机器人政策的视觉-技术中期训练,TouchScale提高了四个接触丰富的操纵任务的平均实际世界成功率,从22.5%提高到57.5%。 随着传感器和收集协议的固定,零发触觉预测和机器人的成功都显示出总体上升趋势,因为使用了更多的触摸尺度数据。 这些结果表明,以一致的感知方式收集的人类视觉-动态数据对认知和机器人操纵都有好处。 我们将公开发布Touch Scale,包括所有同步的视觉-tactile录制和重塑对象模型,以支持未来可伸缩视觉-tactile学习的研究.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: When a person lifts an egg or wrings a wet cloth, the outcome depends on where the fingers press and how hard, yet a camera watching the hand records only its motion. Similarly, egocentric video datasets now span hundreds to thousands of hours of human activity, from everyday tasks to fine-grained hand-object manipulation ( Grauman et al., 2022 ; Grauman et al., 2024 ; Hoque et al., 2026 ) , and have begun to support robot learning ( Kareer et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , yet they capture how hands move while leaving contact and pressure unrecorded. The missing signal is increasingly important for robotics, as tactile sensing has become a common input for contact-rich manipulation ( Yin et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Niu et al., 2026 ) . Existing egocentric visual–tactile datasets provide this signal, but most contain fewer than 30 hours of recorded interaction ( Song et al., 2025 ; Dessalene et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) . Thus the effect of data scale is difficult to study within any single one, and pooling several datasets introduces a second difficulty, as their differences in sensing hardware and collection protocol confound comparisons across them. Although recent studies using egocentric human data have reported favorable scaling trends for downstream robot learning ( Kareer et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Punamiya et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , it remains unclear whether these benefits extend to visual–tactile learning and robotic manipulation when tactile data are collected at the scale of hundreds of hours under a unified sensing pipeline.
blocks.zh: 当一个人抬起一粒鸡蛋或扭动一副湿布时,结果取决于手指按到哪里以及有多用力,然而观看手部的相机只记录出其运动. 同样地,以自我为中心的视频数据集现在跨越了从日常任务到精细的手物体操纵等人类活动的上百到上千小时(Grauman等,2022;Grauman等,2024;Hoque等,2026),并开始支持机器人学习(Kareer等,2025;Zheng等,2026),然而它们却捕捉了手在离开接触和压力时如何行走而未记录. 缺失的信号对机器人越来越重要,因为触觉感知已经成为接触丰富的操纵的常见输入(殷等,2023;袁等,2024;黄等,2025;于等,2025;刘等,2025;牛等,2026). 现有的以自我为中心的视觉-tactile数据集提供这种信号,但大多数数据集包含不到30小时的被记录的相互作用(Song等,2025;Dessalene等,2026;Zhou等,2026b)。 因此,数据尺度的影响很难在任何一个单一的尺度内加以研究,而将若干数据集集中起来,带来了第二个困难,因为它们在遥感硬件和收集协议方面的差异混淆了它们之间的比较。 虽然最近使用自负式人类数据的研究表明,下游机器人学习的放大趋势是有利的(Kareer等,2025年;Zhu等,2026年;Punamiya等,2026年;Zheng等,2026年),但当在统一感知管道下以数百小时的速度收集触觉数据时,这些好处是否扩大到视觉-触觉式学习和机器人操纵仍然不清楚。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce TouchScale , a 500-hour visual–tactile dataset that pairs diverse human interaction with consistent multimodal sensing from a unified wearable capture pipeline. Each recording synchronizes egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB videos and dense full-hand tactile measurements from both hands, and the recordings span everyday activities and structured manipulation tasks with diverse hand motions and interaction patterns. Using the same wearable setup, we record interactions under approximately 2K task descriptions with more than 1.5K objects, spanning 9 high-level collection settings that contain over 800 distinct scene configurations. All recordings share the same generation of sensing hardware and synchronization pipeline, so visual and tactile measurements remain consistent throughout the dataset. The wearable setup can also be deployed repeatedly across participants and environments without requiring manual action annotation, which offers a practical collection paradigm to further scale human visual–tactile data.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Touch Scale,一个500小时的可视-tactile数据集,通过统一的可穿戴捕捉管道,将人类的多种相互作用与一致的多模式感知结合起来。 每次录制都会将以自负为核心的RGB-D视频与手腕RGB视频同步,并用双手进行密集的全手触控测量,录制则会跨越日常活动和结构化的操纵任务,并有不同的手动和互动模式. 使用同样的可穿戴的设置,我们记录了大约2K任务描述下与超过1.5K对象的相互作用,跨越了9个包含800多个不同场景配置的高级收藏设置. 所有录音都共享同代的感知硬件和同步管道,因此整个数据集的视觉和触觉测量始终一致. 可穿戴的设置也可以在参与者和环境之间反复部署,而不需要人工动作注释,这提供了一个实用的收集范式来进一步扩展人类视觉-活性数据.

blocks.en: With TouchScale, we study four questions about large-scale human visual–tactile data. First, we ask whether training on TouchScale enables zero-shot vision-to-touch prediction on a tactile sensor unseen during training. With the same prediction architecture, the model trained on a size-matched 16-hour subset of TouchScale reaches a contact IoU (cIoU) of 0.181 on EgoTactile, compared with 0.134 for the one trained on the 16-hour EgoTouch training split ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) . Second, we ask whether tactile supervision on TouchScale learns visual representations that transfer beyond tactile prediction, and pretraining on TouchScale yields higher action recognition accuracy than pretraining on the compared visual–tactile datasets across three benchmarks under both linear probing and end-to-end fine-tuning. Third, we ask whether human visual–tactile data improves robot policies. Prior work has used tactile observations directly in robot policies or combined human tactile data with action supervision for transfer to robots ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Niu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , whereas we use TouchScale only for visual–tactile mid-training of 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA ( NeoteAI Team and Fudan TEAI Team, 2026 ) without retargeting human hand motion to the robot. This mid-training raises the average real-world success rate on four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. Finally, we ask whether these gains grow with data scale when the sensor and collection protocol stay fixed. Increasing the training data from one tenth of TouchScale to the full dataset raises zero-shot cIoU on EgoTactile from 0.311 to 0.383, and growing the mid-training data from one fifth to the full dataset lifts robot success from 30.0% to 57.5%. Together, these results indicate that large-scale human visual–tactile data benefits embodied learning from perception to robot control, with gains that tend to increase over the range of scales we test.
blocks.zh: 我们用触摸尺度研究了四个关于大规模人类视觉-活性数据的问题。 首先,我们询问,关于触摸尺度的培训是否能够在培训期间不见的触觉传感器上进行零发视向触摸预测。 使用同样的预测架构,在16小时相匹配的Touch Stale子集上训练的模型在EgoTactile上达到了0.181的IoU(cIoU),而接受过16小时EgoTouch分训训练的模型则达到了0.134(周等,2026b). 第二,我们询问触摸比例的触觉监督是否学习了超越触觉预测的视觉表现,而触摸比例的预训比在线性测试和端到端微调下跨越三个基准的相对视觉-触觉数据集的预训更能产生更高的动作识别精度。 第三,我们询问人类的视觉-动态数据是否改善了机器人政策。 先前的工作在机器人政策中直接使用触觉观测,或者将人类触觉数据与动作监督相结合,以转移给机器人(Liu等,2025;Niu等,2026;Zhang等,2026a),而我们使用"触觉". 缩放只用于视觉-tactile中训练 N 0\ mathcal{N}_{0}-VTLA(NeoteAI Team and Fudan TEAI Team, 2026),而不将人手运动重新瞄准机器人. 此次中训将四个接触丰富的操纵任务的平均实相成功率从22.5%提高到了57.5%. 最后,我们询问,当传感器和收集协议固定下来时,这些收益是否随着数据规模的增长而增加。 将培训数据从触摸比例表的十分之一增加到完整的数据集,将EgoTactile上的零发CIoU从0.311提高到0.383,并将培训中数据从五分之一增加到完整的数据集,将机器人的成功率从30.0%提高到57.5%。 这些结果共同表明,大规模人类视觉-动能数据的好处体现了从认知到机器人控制的学习,其收益往往在我们测试的尺度范围内增加。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are: • We introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour human visual–tactile dataset spanning diverse physical interactions, together with a scalable wearable capture paradigm that combines egocentric RGB-D and bimanual wrist RGB cameras with dense full-hand tactile gloves, and we will make the dataset publicly available. • We evaluate TouchScale from perception to robot control. Models trained on TouchScale transfer zero-shot to an unseen tactile sensor, and tactile-supervised pretraining on TouchScale yields visual representations that transfer to action recognition. Used as mid-training supervision without human-to-robot action alignment, TouchScale raises the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. • We study data scaling with the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, varying only the amount of training data. Both zero-shot tactile prediction and real-world manipulation success show an overall upward trend as TouchScale data increases, suggesting that the scaling benefits reported for egocentric video also hold for visual–tactile learning.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献是: 我们引入了Touch Scale,一个500小时的人类视觉-tactile数据集,它跨越了不同的物理相互作用,同时采用了可伸缩可穿戴的捕捉范式,结合了以自负为核心的RGB-D和双手腕RGB相机并配有密集的全手触觉手套,我们将公布数据集。 我们从感知到机器人控制评估触摸尺度 接受过“触摸尺度”培训的模型将零射入一个看不见的触觉传感器,而“触摸尺度”的触觉监督预训则产生可转入动作识别的视觉表现。 《触摸规模》将四个接触丰富的操纵任务的平均实际成功率从22.5%提高到57.5%。 我们研究与传感器和收集协议保持固定的数据比例,只是培训数据的数量不同。 零镜头触觉预测和现实世界操纵的成功都显示随着触摸尺度数据的增长,总体上升趋势,这表明,所报道的以自负为中心视频的缩放效益也适用于视觉-触觉学习。

blocks.en: 2.1 Egocentric Visual–Tactile Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 以Egocentral Visual-Tactile数据集

blocks.en: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of supervision for embodied learning. Existing datasets cover daily activities and manipulation ( Damen et al., 2022 ; Grauman et al., 2022 ; Grauman et al., 2024 ; Hoque et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Punamiya et al., 2026 ; TARS Robotics et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , with recent collections exceeding 20,000 hours ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , but generally lack synchronized tactile measurements. EgoPressure, EgoTactile, and EgoTouch study pressure prediction from egocentric or multi-view video, covering hand–surface contact, object grasping, and bimanual manipulation ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) , while TouchSight introduces TwinTouch-20H by pairing glove recordings with generated bare-hand videos that share the measured tactile labels ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) . OpenTouch and HT-Bench evaluate tactile representations and cross-modal retrieval, with HT-Bench also studying masked tactile modeling and vision-to-tactile synthesis ( Song et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , while FEEL studies force supervision for physical interaction understanding and visual representation learning ( Dessalene et al., 2026 ) . DeskTask-Tac contains 37.2 h of human visual–tactile recordings ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Table 1 compares dataset scale and sensing configurations. TouchScale contains 500 hours collected through a consistent sensing pipeline, with egocentric RGB-D, wrist RGB, and bimanual tactile measurements. We study how data scale affects cross-dataset tactile prediction, transferable visual representations, and robot learning.
blocks.zh: 大规模以自我为中心的人类互动数据正成为监督所体现学习的重要来源。 现有数据集涵盖日常活动和操纵(Damen等,2022;Grauman等,2022;Grauman等,2024;Hoque等,2026;Liu等,2026;Punamiya等,2026;TARS机器人等,2025;Zhang等,2026b),近期采集时间超过20,000小时(郑等,2026),但一般缺乏同步触控测量. EgoPressure,EgoTactile,和EgoTouch研究从以自负为中心或多视图视频得到的压力预测,包括手表接触,取物和双人操纵(赵等,2025;曾等,2026;周等,2026b),而TouchSight介绍双人Touch-20H时,将手套录相与生成的与被测量到的触觉标签相同的光手录相配对(周等,2026a). OpenTouch和HT-Bench评价触觉表现和跨模式取回,而HT-Bench还研究了被蒙住的触觉模型和视向-触觉合成(Song等,2025;Huang等,2026),同时感觉研究力监督物理交互理解和视觉表现学习(Dessalene等,2026). 桌面任务标签包含 37.2h的人类视觉-特效录音(张等,2026a.). 表1比较了数据集尺度和感知配置. 触摸 比例尺包含通过一致的感知管所收集的500小时,其中以自负为中心的RGB-D,手腕RGB,和双相触觉测量. 我们研究数据尺度如何影响跨数据集触觉预测,可转移可视化表现,以及机器人学习.

blocks.en: 2.2 Human Visual–Tactile Data for Robot Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 人类视觉 - 机器人学习技术数据

blocks.en: Human video has been used for visual pretraining and human–robot policy learning ( Nair et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2023 ; Kareer et al., 2025 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Tactile recordings provide direct measurements of contact and pressure, but differences in sensor layout and hand geometry complicate transfer from human hands to robots. Touch in the Wild uses human demonstrations collected with a portable tactile gripper to pretrain visual–tactile representations for downstream manipulation ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . TactAlign and TTP study human–robot transfer through shared tactile representations: TactAlign aligns observations across human and robot sensors, while TTP pretrains on mixed human and robot interaction data using future tactile prediction ( Wi et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Tactile supervision is also used during policy mid-training. T-Rex introduces tactile-rich robot mid-training after large-scale human pretraining without tactile measurements ( Niu et al., 2026 ) , whereas N 0 N_{0} -VTLA trains a future-tactile predictor on robot data before aligning its latent tokens with an action expert ( NeoteAI Team and Fudan TEAI Team, 2026 ) . We use TouchScale for vision-to-tactile mid-training on human recordings without human action labels. The human-data stage does not require retargeting hand motion or matching human and robot action spaces. We then evaluate whether this supervision improves real-robot task success after robot-specific training.
blocks.zh: 人类视频被用于视觉预训和人-机器人政策学习(Nair等,2023;Ma等,2023;Kareer等,2025;Quu等,2025;Yang等,2025)。 Tactile录音提供接触和压力的直接测量,但传感器布局和手几何学的差异使人手向机器人的转移复杂化. 在野地中触摸使用用可移动触觉抓取器收集的人类演示来预演视觉-触觉表现来进行下游操纵(Zhu等人,2025年). TactAlign and TTP 研究人类-机器人通过共享触觉表达的转移: TactAlign将人和机器人传感器的观测对等,而TTP则利用未来的触觉预测对人和机器人混合相互作用数据进行预留(Wi等,2026;张等,2026a). 在政策中期培训中,也使用Tactile监督。 T-Rex在未经触觉测量的大规模人类预训后引入了触觉丰富的机器人中训(Niu等,2026年),而N0 N_{0}-VTLA在与动作专家(NeoteAI Team和Fudan TEAI Team,2026年)对接后,先在机器人数据上训练出未来触觉预测器. 我们使用触摸模型来进行关于人类录音的视觉到触摸的中期培训,而无需人类行动标签。 人类数据阶段不需要重新瞄准手动或者匹配人和机器人的动作空间. 然后,我们评价这种监督是否改进了机器人特定训练后的实际机器人任务的成功。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Collection Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据收集 设置

blocks.en: TouchScale uses a unified wearable setup for human visual–tactile data collection, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . The setup combines an egocentric RGB-D camera, two wrist-mounted RGB cameras, and bimanual tactile gloves.
blocks.zh: 触摸尺度使用统一的可穿戴装置,用于人类视觉-触摸数据收集,如图所示。 2,设置结合了以自负为核心的RGB-D相机,两台手腕搭载的RGB相机,和双人触觉手套.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , we use an Orbbec Gemini 345Lg stereo RGB-D camera as the egocentric sensor, recording RGB at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 and depth at 640 × 480 640\times 480 , both at 30 Hz. The depth stream provides metric 3D scene geometry from the egocentric view throughout the interaction. Two Intel RealSense D405 cameras are mounted on the wrists and record RGB at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 and 30 Hz. The egocentric camera captures the overall interaction, while the wrist cameras provide close-up views of hand–object interaction and complement the egocentric view when contact is partially occluded.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们使用一款Orbbec双子座345Lg立体RGB-D相机作为自我中心传感器,录制RGB时为1280×720 1280\times 720,深度为640×480 640\times 480,均以30Hz. 深度流在整个互动过程中从自负中心视角提供度量3D场景几何. 手腕上挂有两台Intel RealSense D405相机,并记录了RGB在1280×720 1280\times 720和30 Hz. 以自我为中心的相机能捕捉整体交互,而腕相机则提供手-对象交互的特写视图,并在接触被部分占用时补充以自我为中心的视角.

blocks.en: We use flexible tactile sensing gloves to record bimanual tactile signals during interaction, as shown in Fig. 2 . Each glove contains 880 sensing taxels distributed across the five fingers and palm, with a spatial resolution below 2 mm. The dense sensing layout provides hand-wide coverage of contact during manipulation. The gloves record normal tactile pressure across the hand. Additional hardware specifications and the sensor layout are provided in Appendix 7 .
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们使用灵活的触觉感应手套记录互动过程中的双相触觉信号。 每只手套有分布于5个手指和棕榈的880个感应分类器,空间分辨率低于2毫米. 密集的感知布局为操纵过程中的接触提供了全手覆盖. 手套记录了正常的触觉压力 附录7提供了额外的硬件规格和传感器布局。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Collection and Task Design
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据收集和任务设计

blocks.en: TouchScale contains approximately 2K task descriptions across 9 high-level collection settings and 800+ distinct scene configurations, including laboratory, kitchen, workbench, office, bedroom, medical, and packing environments. Laboratory, kitchen, and workbench activities account for the largest portions of the collection. The tasks cover transport and placement, pouring and transfer, insertion and alignment, tool use, opening and closing, folding, wiping, pressing, and other contact-rich interactions, including both single-hand and bimanual manipulation. As shown in Fig. 3 , place is the most frequent task verb, followed by pour , transfer , and put , with many other interaction types represented throughout the dataset. Each task is written as a natural-language instruction with an explicit action, the manipulated object or objects, and the intended interaction or target state. When needed, the instruction further specifies the tool, target location, execution order, hand use, or completion condition. Representative examples in Fig. 3 include “Swirl a glass Erlenmeyer flask with both hands,” “Pour water from a pitcher into a wide-mouth water bottle,” “Coil a laptop charging cable and secure it with a hook-and-loop strap,” and “Seal the center seam on top of a box with a tape dispenser.”
blocks.zh: 触摸尺度包含大约2K项任务描述,涉及9个高级采集设置和800多个不同的场景配置,包括实验室、厨房、工作台、办公室、卧室、医疗和包装环境。 实验室、厨房和工作室的活动占收集工作的最大部分。 任务包括运输和布置、倒入和转移、插入和对接、工具使用、打开和关闭、折叠、擦拭、压取,以及包括单手和双手操纵在内的其他内容丰富的互动。 如图3所示,位置是最常见的任务动词,然后是倒出、传输和放出,在整个数据集中代表许多其他交互类型。 每项任务被写成一种自然语言的指令,带有明确的动作,被被操纵的物体,以及预定的交互或目标状态. 需要时,指令会进一步规定工具,目标位置,执行命令,手用或完成条件. 图3中有代表性的例子包括“用双手旋转玻璃埃伦迈尔瓶子”,“从投出器倒入宽口水瓶;将笔记本电脑充电电缆并用钩接绳接住”和“将中央接上装有带子的容器上方。 “

blocks.en: The 500-hour collection includes 1.5k+ objects spanning different geometries, materials, and physical properties. For repeated recordings of a task, we vary object instances and initial configurations, including object position, orientation, relative arrangement, and scene layout. Approximately 20 participants contribute to the collection, producing differences in grasp choice, movement timing, hand coordination, contact sequence, and motion trajectory even under the same task instruction. These variations lead to different hand–object poses and tactile contact patterns across repeated executions. Fig. 3 shows distinct contact distributions for tightening a screw, pipetting liquid, and wringing a cloth, while Fig. 2 shows how contact evolves as a wet cloth is grasped, wrung, and released. We additionally provide reconstructed 3D objects from object-centric RGB captures, and the procedure is described in Appendix 11 .
blocks.zh: 500小时的收集包括1.5k+物体,它们跨越不同的几何、材料和物理特性。 对于一个任务的重复录音,我们改变对象实例和初始配置,包括对象位置,取向,相对安排,以及场景布局. 大约20名参与者为收集工作作出贡献,在把握选择、移动时间、手相协调、接触顺序和运动轨迹方面产生差异,甚至根据同一任务指示。 这些变化导致在反复处决中形成不同的手-手-物和触觉接触模式。 图3显示不同的接触分布,用于收紧螺丝管,吸管液体和扭打布;而图2显示接触是如何随着湿布被抓住,被扭伤并被放出而演变的. 我们从以对象为中心的 RGB 抓取中额外提供重建的 三维对象,该程序在附录11中描述.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 10 , we use an automated quality-control pipeline that cross-checks tactile recordings against wrist-view observations. For each hand, Gemini 3.7 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) first identifies grasp intervals, release events, visually confirmed contact fingers, and contact-free periods from the wrist video without access to tactile measurements. This blind visual pass provides an independent reference for evaluating the tactile signals. We reject recordings with clear sensor failures, including whole-hand signal loss during visually confirmed interaction and high-confidence persistent multi-finger signal failures. Missing responses from individual fingers are instead sent for manual review, since finger-level contact can be visually ambiguous. Fingers that respond elsewhere in the episode are not treated as failures when they are silent during a particular grasp. We separately screen contact-free periods for persistent tactile activity and use a second visual check to distinguish sensor noise from unobserved physical contact. More details can be found in Appendix 8 .
blocks.zh: 如图10所示,我们使用自动质量控制管道,对照手腕视图观察,交叉检查触觉记录。 对于每只手,双子座 3.7 Flash(Google DeepMind,2026年)首先识别出抓取间隔,放出事件,视觉上确认的接触指,以及手腕视频上没有触觉测量的无接触期. 这种盲目的视觉通路为评价触觉信号提供了独立的参考. 我们拒绝有明显传感器故障的录音,包括视觉确认互动过程中的全手信号丢失和高自信持续多指信号故障. 个人手指的缺失答复则被送交人工审查,因为手指一级的接触可能视觉上模糊不清。 在剧集其他部分反应的指子,如果在特定的抓取中沉默不语,则不被视为失败. 我们为持续触觉活动单独筛选无接触期,并使用第二次视觉检查来区分传感器噪声与未观察到的物理接触. 详见附录8。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We examine the four questions above through three experimental settings. First, we evaluate cross-dataset zero-shot tactile prediction on EgoTactile and analyze how performance changes with the amount of TouchScale training data. Second, we evaluate whether tactile-supervised pretraining on TouchScale learns transferable visual representations across three downstream action recognition benchmarks under both linear probing and end-to-end fine-tuning. Finally, we evaluate TouchScale as action-free visual–tactile mid-training for 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA on four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, and further study how robot success and future-tactile prediction change with the amount of TouchScale mid-training data.
blocks.zh: 我们通过三个实验环境来研究上述四个问题。 首先,我们评价EgoTactile上的跨数据集零发触控预测,并分析性能如何随着TouchStale训练数据的数量而变化. 第二,我们评价触觉监督的触摸尺度预训是否在线性测试和端到端微调下,通过三个下游行动识别基准学习可转移的视觉表现。 最后,我们评价Touch Scale为无动作可视-Tactile中期训练N 0\ mathcal{N}_{0}-VTLA关于四个真实世界接触丰富的操纵任务的训练,并进一步研究机器人成功和未来活动预测如何随着Touch Scale中期训练数据的数量而变化.

Ground-truth pressure is normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by the maximum pressure within each sequence.
Each dataset retains its native tactile layout during training. Because the sensors differ in spatial layout and sensing density, we map their tactile prediction to a common set of 12 anatomical hand regions for evaluation.

blocks.en: 4.2 Visual Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 4.2 视觉代表性学习

blocks.en:
We next evaluate the transferability of visual representations learned from TouchScale. We pretrain Hiera-B ( Ryali et al., 2023 ) separately on TouchScale, OpenTouch ( Song et al., 2025 ) , FEEL ( Dessalene et al., 2026 ) , and EgoTouch ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) , using the same tactile prediction objective. All encoders are initialized from the same pretrained Hiera-B checkpoint and trained with the same optimization schedule and training budget. We evaluate the resulting encoders on MECCANO ( Ragusa et al., 2021 ) , Something-Something V2 (SSv2) ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) , and Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) under both linear probing and end-to-end fine-tuning.
Table 3 shows that TouchScale achieves the highest accuracy across all three downstream benchmarks under both evaluation settings. It reaches an average linear-probe accuracy of 24.45% and an average fine-tuning accuracy of 49.62%, outperforming the existing visual–tactile pretraining datasets. These results show that TouchScale learns more transferable visual representations for downstream action recognition.

blocks.en: 4.3 Transfer to Robotic Manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.3 转让给机器人操纵

blocks.en: We build on 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA ( NeoteAI Team and Fudan TEAI Team, 2026 ) , a vision–tactile–language–action policy for contact-rich manipulation that takes visual observations, language instructions, robot state, and tactile input to predict robot actions. Given the current tactile observation and visual–language context, 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA predicts latent tactile tokens that represent the expected tactile change over the coming action chunk and conditions the action expert on these tokens for action prediction. In Stage 1, these latent tactile tokens are trained against a future-tactile target obtained by encoding the tactile change over the same horizon. We follow the Stage-1 future-tactile prediction formulation while adapting the training pipeline to TouchScale before robot post-training, and refer to this stage as TouchScale mid-training. Details are provided in Appendix 10.2 .

The TouchScale variant first undergoes TouchScale mid-training and is then post-trained on our robot demonstrations. The baseline skips TouchScale mid-training and is directly post-trained on the same robot demonstrations using the same protocol. The two variants therefore differ only in whether TouchScale mid-training is performed before robot post-training.

blocks.en: Our real-world setup is shown in Fig. 5 . We use an xArm6 robotic arm with a BrainCo Revo 2 robotic hand, a tactile-sensing glove mounted on the hand, an external RGB-D camera, and a wrist camera. We collect 50 demonstrations per task through human teleoperation using a VR headset, a pair of trackers, and motion-capture gloves. We evaluate four contact-rich manipulation tasks with different interaction requirements. In Soft/Hard Sorting , the robot identifies the soft object through physical interaction and places it at the target location. In Bottle-Cap Removal , the robot picks up a bottle cap and places it into a target container. In Test-Tube Transfer , the robot picks up a test tube and transfers it to a target location. In Whiteboard Wipe , the robot wipes a marked area on the whiteboard with a cloth while maintaining sustained contact with the surface. For evaluation, we vary the initial configurations of the objects and targets across trials and report the task success rate. Both model variants follow the same evaluation protocol.

blocks.en: Table 4 compares 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA with and without TouchScale mid-training. TouchScale mid-training improves success on all four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, increasing the average success rate from 22.5% to 57.5%, an absolute gain of 35 percentage points. The largest improvement is observed on Soft/Hard Sorting, where success increases from 10% to 60%. Bottle-Cap Removal improves from 40% to 70%, Test-Tube Transfer from 30% to 60%, and Whiteboard Wipe from 10% to 40%. These consistent gains span material discrimination, small-object manipulation, precise transfer, and continuous-contact manipulation, showing that the benefit of TouchScale mid-training extends across different forms of physical interaction. Overall, these results demonstrate that TouchScale mid-training substantially improves real-world contact-rich robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 表4 比较 N 0 \ mathcal{N}_{0} - VTLA 有和无触摸比例的中训. 触摸 规模化中训提升了所有四个现实世界接触丰富的操纵任务的成功率,将平均成功率从22.5%提高到了57.5%,绝对增收35个百分点. 在Soft/Hard S排序上观察到最大的改进,成功率从10%增加到了60%。 瓶卡清除率从40%提高到70%,试管转移率从30%提高到60%,白板擦拭率从10%提高到40%。 这些持续收益涉及物质歧视、小物体操纵、精确转移和连续接触操纵,表明触摸规模中期训练的好处涉及不同形式的物理互动。 总体而言,这些结果表明,触摸规模中期培训大大改进了现实世界接触丰富的机器人操纵。

blocks.en: We next examine how policy performance changes with the amount of TouchScale data used during mid-training. For each data scale, we perform TouchScale mid-training and then post-train the policy on the same robot demonstrations using the same protocol. As shown in Fig. 6 (left), the average success rate across all four real-world tasks increases from 22.5% without TouchScale mid-training to 30.0%, 32.5%, 50.0%, 50.0%, and 57.5% when using 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100% of TouchScale, respectively. The results show an overall positive scaling trend, with larger amounts of human visual–tactile mid-training data leading to stronger downstream robot performance.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们审查政策业绩如何随着中期培训中使用的触摸尺度数据量而变化。 对于每个数据尺度,我们执行"触摸尺度"(Touchscale)中期训练,然后使用同一种协议对同一个机器人演示进行后训练的政策. 如图6(左)所示,所有四个现实世界任务的平均成功率分别从22.5%和30.0 %,32.5%、50.0 %、50.0 %和57.5%,在使用20%、40%、60%、80%和100%的触摸比例时,分别从22.5%和32.5%增至32.5%。 结果显示总体呈正规模趋势,更多的人类视觉-动能中培训数据导致下游机器人性能更强.

blocks.zh: 图6:触摸的放大 缩放中训. 左:训练后平均成功率,涉及四个现实世界的操控任务,拥有不同量的"触摸尺度"中级训练数据. 右:在TouchScale中期训练中未见的机器人数据上的未来活性预测精度.

blocks.en: We explore how TouchScale data scale affects the tactile world modeling during mid-training. Given the current tactile observation and visual–language context, the model predicts latent tactile tokens representing the expected tactile change over the future horizon. We evaluate these predictions on the robot data unseen during TouchScale mid-training, before robot post-training. As shown in Fig. 6 (right), future-tactile prediction accuracy increases from 2.87% with 20% of TouchScale to 3.31% with the full dataset, compared with 0.18% without TouchScale mid-training. These results show that TouchScale mid-training improves future-tactile prediction on robot observations, while the gain from increasing the amount of human visual–tactile data from 20% to 100% is modest. Details are provided in Appendix 9 .
blocks.zh: 我们探索了触摸尺度数据尺度如何影响中训期间触摸世界模型. 鉴于目前的触觉观察和视觉-语言背景,该模型预测潜在的触觉符号,代表未来预期会发生的触觉变化。 我们评估这些预测 在机器人训练前 在触摸模型中期训练中 看不见的机器人数据上 如图6(右)所示,未来动能预测精度从2.87%(触摸分数的20%)增加到3.31%(完整的数据集),而没有触摸分数的中训率为0.18%。 这些结果显示,TouchScale中期训练改善了对机器人观测的未来活性预测,而将人类视觉-活性数据的数量从20%增加到100%则收益不大。 详情见附录9。

blocks.en: We further examine the relation between future-tactile prediction and action prediction after post-training on robot data. On held-out robot data, we compute the Pearson correlation coefficient between the per-step future-tactile prediction error and action prediction error. With TouchScale mid-training, the two errors show a weak positive correlation ( r = 0.119 r=0.119 , p = 0.020 p=0.020 ), whereas the baseline shows essentially no correlation ( r = 0.003 r=0.003 , p = 0.953 p=0.953 ). This result suggests a limited but detectable association between future-tactile prediction and downstream action prediction after mid-training.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查机器人数据培训后的未来活性预测和行动预测之间的关系。 在被搁置的机器人数据上,我们计算出每步未来活性预测出错和动作预测出错之间的皮尔逊相关系数. 在触摸分级中训练中,这两个错误显示出微弱的正相关关系(r = 0.119 r = 0.119,p = 0.020 p = 0.020),而基线则显示基本上没有相关关系(r = 0.003 r = 0.003,p = 0.953 p = 0.953 ) , 这表明未来活性预测与中训练后下游动作预测之间存在有限但可察觉的联系.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour human visual–tactile dataset collected with a consistent sensing and synchronization pipeline. Training on TouchScale improves zero-shot tactile prediction and visual representation learning for downstream action recognition, while mid-training with TouchScale benefits real-world robot manipulation. The scaling results further show overall positive trends as more TouchScale data is used, highlighting the value of large-scale human visual–tactile data for embodied learning. Together, these results validate synchronized human vision and touch as a highly effective supervisory signal for both perception and robotic control. Our current robot evaluation is limited to one platform and four manipulation tasks, and TouchScale does not include action labels. Broader evaluation across robot embodiments and contact-rich tasks remains future work. We also observe only a weak association between future-tactile and action prediction errors, and the role of future-tactile prediction in robot control remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Touch Scale, 一个500小时的人类视觉-动能数据集, 用一致的感知和同步管道收集。 关于触摸比例的培训改进了零发触觉预测和视觉表现学习,以进行下游动作识别,而带有触摸比例的中期培训则有利于现实世界机器人的操纵。 衡量结果进一步表明,随着使用更多的触摸尺度数据,总体趋势是积极的,突出了大规模人类视觉-动能数据对体现学习的价值。 这些结果共同验证出同步的人类视觉和触摸,作为感知和机器人控制高度有效的监督信号. 我们目前的机器人评价仅限于一个平台和四个操纵任务,而"触摸规模"并不包括动作标签. 今后的工作仍然是更广泛地评价机器人的化身和丰富的接触任务。 我们还只观察到未来-活性与动作预测错误之间的微弱关联,未来-活性预测在机器人控制中的作用仍然是一个有待解决的问题.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Tactile glove hardware. The Tachin Glove used in TouchScale contains an acquisition module on the dorsal side, while tactile sensing regions cover the five fingers and palm on the palmar side. The glove is connected to an external power module for wearable tactile recording.

blocks.en: We use flexible tactile sensing gloves (Tachin Glove) for full-hand tactile data collection. Each glove contains 880 sensing taxels distributed over the five fingers and palm, as illustrated in Fig. 9 . Each sensing unit measures 1.5 × 1.5 1.5\times 1.5 mm, and the glove provides a spatial resolution below 2 mm. The sensing layer records normal tactile pressure. The measurement range is 0.2–30 N/cm 2 , with a resolution of 0.05 N/cm 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用灵活的触觉感应手套(Tachin Glove)来收集全手触觉数据。 每只手套中包含分布于五指和掌上880个感应分解的分解分解物,如Fig所示. 9. 每个感应单位测量1.5×1.5 1.5相1.5毫米,手套提供2毫米以下的空间分辨率。 感地层记录出正常的触觉压力. 测量范围为0.2-30 N/cm 2,分辨率为0.05 N/cm 2.

blocks.en: The sensing layer is connected to an acquisition module mounted on the back of the hand and an external power module. The glove supports wireless acquisition at 50 Hz over WiFi and wired acquisition at 100 Hz through USB Type-C. The battery module supports more than 10 hours of continuous operation. Together, these components form the wearable tactile acquisition system used throughout data collection.
blocks.zh: 感应层与安装在手后部的获取模块和外部动力模块相接. 手套通过USB Type-C支持以50Hz在WiFi上进行无线获取,并用100Hz进行有线获取. 电池模块支持超过10小时的持续运行. 这些组成部分共同构成整个数据收集过程中使用的可穿戴触觉获取系统。

blocks.en: 8 Tactile Data Quality Control
blocks.zh: 8 Tactile 数据质量 控制权

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Postprocessing for data quality. Contact events and engaged fingers are first identified from wrist video without tactile input, then compared with tactile responses to detect missing signals. The resulting consistency check assigns PASS, REVIEW, or REJECT, with uncertain cases sent for human inspection.
blocks.zh: 图10:数据质量后处理。 接触事件和接触手指首先从手腕视频中识别出,没有触觉输入,再与触觉反应进行比较以检测缺失信号. 由此产生的一致性检查指定了PASS, Review, 或REJECT, 将不确定的案件送交人为检查.

blocks.en: Data are captured by Noitom under our contracted data-collection process. Noitom obtains informed consent from participants prior to data collection and performs an initial vendor-side quality check before delivery to us. We then apply our own quality-control procedure at the batch, episode, and hand levels. At the batch level, we first check that the required camera streams, timestamps, tactile recordings, and task metadata are present for each episode. We also compute basic integrity statistics, including agreement between video frame counts and timestamps, irregular frame intervals, consistency of recording duration across streams, and interruptions in tactile sampling. These statistics are stored for inspection but are not used directly to determine data quality. We additionally render a synchronized visualization of the camera streams, tactile hand maps, and pressure traces for later review. Each valid episode is then processed independently for the left and right hands. The final episode label is determined by the more severe hand-level result: Reject , Review , or Pass .
blocks.zh: 数据由诺伊托姆根据我们的合同数据收集程序收集。 诺伊托姆在收集数据之前获得参与者的知情同意,并在交付我们之前进行供应商侧质量初步检查。 然后我们在批量、分集和手级应用我们自己的质量控制程序。 在批量层面,我们首先检查每集所需的相机流,时间戳,触觉录音,以及任务元数据是否存在. 我们还计算基本完整性统计,包括视频帧计数和时间戳之间的一致,不规则帧间隔,跨流记录持续时间的一致性,以及触觉取样的中断. 这些统计数据储存起来以供检查,但并不直接用于确定数据质量。 我们还对相机流、触觉手图和压力痕迹进行同步可视化,供日后审查。 然后,每个有效插曲对左右手进行独立处理. 最后剧集标签由更严厉的手级结果决定:拒绝,评论,或Pass.

blocks.en: For each hand, we first test whether all tactile measurements remain below a small response threshold throughout the episode. We use a normalized threshold of 0.03 0.03 . A fully silent hand is not considered faulty by itself, since the hand may simply remain unused. To determine whether contact is expected, we run Gemini-3.7-Flash on the corresponding wrist-view video at 2 fps without providing any tactile information. The model identifies grasp and release intervals, fingers that are visibly involved in each contact, fingers whose contact state is uncertain, and intervals in which the hand is visually free. This blind visual pass provides an independent reference for evaluating the tactile recordings. A fully silent hand is rejected only when the visual analysis confirms that the hand interacts with an object.
blocks.zh: 对于每一只手,我们首先测试在整个剧集中所有触觉测量是否仍然低于一个小响应阈值. 我们使用的正常门槛是0.03 0.03 完全沉默的手本身并不被认为是有问题的,因为手可能只是没有使用。 为了确定是否需要接触,我们在2英尺处运行相应的手腕视图视频上的双子座-3.7-Flash,但没有提供任何触觉信息. 模型识别出抓取和放出间隔,每个接触中明显涉及的手指,接触状态不确定的手指,以及手被视自由的间隔. 这种盲目视觉通行证为评价触觉录音提供了独立的参考. 完全无声的手只有在视觉分析确认手与物体相互作用时才会被拒绝.

blocks.en: For finger-level analysis, tactile measurements are grouped by finger, using the maximum response over the tip, middle, and base regions, with an additional trace for the palm. Values below the response threshold are treated as zero. We evaluate visually confirmed contacts on the thumb, index, middle, and ring fingers; the little finger and palm are excluded from the missing-signal decision because their contact state is less reliable from the wrist view. For each contact interval, we identify confirmed contact fingers whose tactile response remains zero. If all confirmed contact fingers in an interval are silent, at least two such fingers are involved, and these fingers also remain unresponsive throughout the episode, we treat the case as a high-confidence sensor failure and assign Reject . A finger that remains unresponsive throughout the episode without this multi-finger evidence results in Review . If the same finger responds elsewhere in the episode, the missing response is treated as uncertain rather than as a sensor failure.
blocks.zh: 对于指平面分析,触觉测量用指平面来分组,使用尖地,中地和基地上的最大反应来进行,并给掌上再加一个痕量. 低于响应阈值的值被作为零处理. 我们评估拇指、索引、中指和指环上的视觉确认接触;小指和手掌被排除在缺失信号决定之外,因为他们的接触状态从手腕视图来看不太可靠。 对于每个接触间隔,我们发现确认的接触指,其触觉反应为零. 如果一个间隔中所有确认的接触指都沉默了,至少涉及两个这样的指头,而且在整个剧集中这些指头也一直没有反应,我们把案件视为高自信感应故障,并指定拒绝. 在整个剧集中没有反应的指头, 如果同一指在剧集中的其他部分做出回应,缺失的响应被视作不确定而非感应失败.

blocks.en: We separately examine tactile activity during intervals that the visual pass identifies as contact-free. Continuous responses above the same threshold lasting at least 0.3 s are collected as noise candidates. Candidates are ranked by their duration and peak response, and the five strongest are retained for verification. For each candidate, Gemini-3.7-Flash receives a short clip containing the enlarged tactile visualization alongside the synchronized wrist view, with 1.5 s of context before and after the candidate at 6 fps. Unlike the first VLM call, this second call has access to both visual and tactile information and is used only to determine whether the apparent tactile activity occurs while the hand is truly free of contact. Candidates explained by visible contact are discarded; confirmed contact-free responses are recorded as tactile noise.
blocks.zh: 我们分别检查视觉通行证所标明的无接触间隔期间的触觉活动。 超过同一阈值的连续反应至少0.3 s被收集为噪声候选反应. 考生按年限和峰值响应排行,5名最强者留校核查. 对每个候选人来说,双子座-3.7-Flash收到一个短片,包含与同步手腕视图相并列的放大触觉可视化,在6英尺时段,在候选人前后有1.5个上下文. 与第一个VLM呼叫不同的是,这个第二个呼叫既可以获取视觉信息,也可以获取触觉信息,并且仅用于确定是否在手真正自由接触时发生了明显的触觉活性. 以可见接触解释的候选人被丢弃;确认的无接触反应被记录为触觉噪声.

blocks.en: Tactile noise does not independently determine the Reject / Review / Pass label. We record its timing, cumulative duration, fraction of visually free time, and affected fingers for quality analysis. blocks.en: 10.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 10.2 执行细节

blocks.en: We initialize from the officially released 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA checkpoint and follow its Stage-1 future-tactile prediction formulation while adapting the training pipeline to TouchScale. During TouchScale mid-training, the vision–language–action backbone is frozen and no human action labels are used. We update only the tactile projection layer, the tactile predictor, and an auxiliary tactile reconstruction head. The predictor uses the tactile_kv architecture with five latent tactile tokens, matching the released checkpoint configuration. Given the current tactile observation together with visual–language context, the predictor produces latent tactile tokens that represent the expected tactile change over a future horizon of H = 50 H=50 frames.
blocks.zh: 我们从官方公布的 N 0\ mathcal{N}_{0} - VTLA 检查点初始化,并遵循其阶段-1 未来活性预测配方,同时将训练管道调整为 Touch Scale 。 触摸时 缩放中期训练,视觉-语言-动作主干被冻结,没有使用人类动作标签. 我们只更新触觉投影层,触觉预测器,以及辅助触觉重建头. 预测器使用有5个潜在触觉符的触觉_kv架构,匹配了已放行的检查站配置. 鉴于目前的触觉观察以及视觉-语言背景,预测器会产生潜在触觉符号,代表未来H=50H=50帧的预期触觉变化。

blocks.en: For each training sample, the future-tactile target is constructed from the tactile change between the current observation and the observation at t + H t+H . This tactile change is encoded with the tactile encoder, and targets from the available tactile views are averaged to obtain the target latent representation z ∗ z^{*} . The target branch is stop-gradient during Stage-1 training. We mean-pool and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalize the predicted and target latent tactile representations and optimize a symmetric InfoNCE objective over the global training batch. In addition, a two-layer reconstruction head maps the predicted latent tactile tokens to an 8 × 8 8\times 8 representation of the corresponding future tactile change. The Stage-1 objective is ℒ mid = ℒ NCE + λ rec ​ ℒ rec , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mid}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{NCE}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{rec}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}}, (22) where ℒ rec \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}} is an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} reconstruction loss and λ rec = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{rec}}=0.5 . We use a temperature of 0.07 0.07 for the contrastive objective.

blocks.en: We optimize the trainable tactile pathway with AdamW using a global batch size of 64 and gradient clipping at 1.0. The learning rate is warmed up for 500 steps to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and then decayed to 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} by 20K steps. Approximately 123.8M parameters are updated during TouchScale mid-training, while the remaining 3.71B parameters of the base policy remain frozen. The vision–language backbone is kept in evaluation mode and evaluated without gradient computation throughout this stage.
blocks.zh: 我们优化了与AdamW的可训练触觉通道 采用了64个全球批量尺寸 并用1.0来剪接梯度。 学习速度被热到500步到1×10-4 1\times 10×4}然后被衰变到1×10-5 1\times 10×5}到20K步. 在 " 触摸规模 " 中期培训期间,大约123.8M参数得到更新,而基础政策的其余3.71B参数仍然被冻结。 愿景-语言主干线始终处于评价模式,在整个阶段没有进行梯度计算。

blocks.en: TouchScale recordings retain their original timestamps in the released dataset. For 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA mid-training, the three RGB streams and two tactile streams are converted to a common 30 Hz training timeline using timestamp-based nearest-neighbor association. This conversion is performed only when constructing the model training samples and does not modify the original TouchScale recordings. We use fixed tactile normalization statistics estimated from the training split and apply the same normalization throughout mid-training.
blocks.zh: 触摸比例记录保留了在所发布的数据集中的原始时间戳. 用于 N 0\ mathcal{ N\\\0} -VTLA中训,三道RGB流和两道触觉流被转换为共同的30个Hz培训时间表,使用基于时间戳的近邻相通. 只有在构建模型训练样品时进行这种转换,而不修改原始的触摸分解录相. 我们使用从培训分离中估计的固定触觉正常化统计数据,在整个培训中期实行同样的正常化。

blocks.en: After TouchScale mid-training, the resulting checkpoint is post-trained on our robotic demonstrations using the 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA robot adaptation pipeline. The baseline starts from the same released checkpoint but skips TouchScale mid-training. Both variants are post-trained with the same 50 robot demonstrations per task and the same optimization and data-processing protocol. Thus, the only difference between the two variants is whether the tactile predictor receives action-free human visual–tactile mid-training on TouchScale before robot post-training.
blocks.zh: 使用N 0\ mathcal{N}_{0}-VTLA机器人改造管道, 基线从同一个已放行的检查站开始,但跳过触摸比例的中期训练。 两个变体都是经过后期训练的,每个任务都有相同的50个机器人演示以及相同的优化和数据处理协议. 因此,这两个变体之间唯一的区别是,触觉预测器在机器人训练后是否接受无动作的人类视觉-触觉图的中期训练.

blocks.en: 11 3D Object Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 11 三维对象重建

blocks.en: For objects in TouchScale, we record short object-centric RGB videos by moving the camera around each object to capture it from multiple viewpoints. We select several frames in which the object is fully visible and segment the foreground object from the background. The resulting multi-view RGB images are provided to the Meshy Multi-Image-to-3D API to reconstruct a 3D model for each object. These reconstructed object models are provided together with TouchScale.
blocks.zh: 对于"触摸尺度"中的对象,我们通过将相机围绕每个对象移动来记录以对象为中心的短片RGB,从多角度捕捉. 我们选择了多个框架,其中对象完全可见,并从背景中分出前景对象. 由此产生的多视图RGB图像提供给了Messy多图像到3D API来为每个对象重建一个3D模型. 这些被重建的物体模型与触摸尺度一起提供。
